args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. A gassy smell is treated as an emergency, even if it's only occasional. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, flames or lighters near it. Open windows, and if you smell gas again leave the flat and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). Call 999 if anyone is in immediate danger. We are arranging a Gas Safe registered engineer as an emergency, with a target of within 24 hours. No firm is confirmed yet and we will confirm the visit with you as soon as we have it. The oven not heating will be looked at at the same time. We will update you today.
